title: Sign in successfully to access the dashboard
description: Verifies an existing user can sign in with valid credentials and reach the dashboard.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the user lands on the dashboard at /app

title: Redirect unauthenticated user from dashboard route to login
description: Verifies attempting to access the dashboard while logged out redirects the user to the login page or blocks access.

steps.description: Verify the user is blocked from the dashboard and prompted to log in

title: Register then sign in to reach the dashboard
description: Verifies a new user can register, then log in with the same credentials, and land on the dashboard.

steps.description: Fill "Advus Auth User" into the name field
Verify the user lands on the dashboard at /app

title: Access dashboard directly while authenticated
description: Verifies an authenticated user can navigate directly to the dashboard route and see the dashboard overview and navigation.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the dashboard overview and core navigation are displayed

title: Convert from landing page to successful account registration
description: Verifies a visitor can review the landing page, navigate to registration, create an account, and see an account creation confirmation.

steps.description: Click the call-to-action to create an account
Fill "Advus Test User" into the name field
Verify an account creation confirmation is visible

title: Request password recovery from forgot-password
description: Verifies a user can submit an email address on the forgot-password page and see a recovery request confirmation.

steps.description: Verify a password recovery confirmation is visible

title: Show required-field validation on registration from landing page
description: Verifies a visitor can reach registration from the landing page and is prevented from submitting when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Scroll through the main marketing content
Click the call-to-action to create an account
Verify required-field validation errors are visible

title: Prevent reset-password submission when confirmation does not match
description: Verifies the reset-password form blocks submission when the new password and confirmation do not match.

steps.description: Fill "ValidPass123!" into the new password field
Fill "DifferentPass123!" into the confirm password field
Verify a password mismatch validation error is visible

title: Reject sign-in with incorrect password
description: Verifies the login form shows an invalid-credentials error when the password is incorrect.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Verify an invalid-credentials error is visible
